biotools.summary: TmDet is a web server that determines the orientation of transmembrane proteins within lipid bilayers based on their 3D structure, providing information about structural elements and assessing model embeddability. It addresses challenges arising from AI-predicted protein structures and supports various transmembrane protein types.
